title: sarcococca hookeriana var. humilis
intro: Sarcococca hookeriana var. humilis, commonly known as Sweet Box or Christmas Box, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to Western China. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. By consuming Sarcococca hookeriana var. humilis, individuals may experience relief from stress and anxiety, as well as improved sleep quality.
